method: Rates are as of 2026-10-22 (or each bank's most recent dated disclosure) and are variable unless the source says otherwise. The one-year scenario assumes one lump-sum deposit on 2026-10-22, no additions or withdrawals, and today's applicable APY remains unchanged through 2027-10-22; estimated gross interest = principal × APY, rounded to the nearest dollar. Three- and five-year tables are hypothetical constant-rate compounding illustrations only for products where today's standard variable rate and balance tier can be reasonably applied; they are not forecasts or guarantees. Promotional, location-unconfirmed, and officially conflicting rates are not projected beyond one year. Fees, taxes, and cash bonuses are excluded from rate-based return tables. Wells Fargo's current promotional rate is applied only at qualifying balances and for one year only. Citi's blended APY applies only to the eligible one-year promotion and qualifying $25,000+ New-to-Citibank balance.

fdic.rule: FDIC coverage is generally $250,000 per depositor, per FDIC-insured bank, per account ownership category. Deposits in the same category at one bank are aggregated, including principal and accrued interest. Actual coverage depends on ownership/titling and all deposits held at that bank.

products.rateNotes: Standard variable APY; account terms say maximum balance limits apply. Marcus's own FAQ states $1,000,000 per online savings account and $3,000,000 total per account owner across deposit accounts. Those are bank product limits, not FDIC coverage limits.
products.fees: No fees stated for this account.
products.access: Online and mobile banking; same-day transfer processing for eligible transfers of $100,000 or less, subject to conditions.
products.opening: No minimum opening deposit. Fund within 60 days or the bank may close the account. Applicant must meet account approval requirements. Maximum balance limits apply.
products.offer: Referral rate boost: a new customer opening through an existing Marcus customer's unique referral link can receive +1.00 percentage point APY for 3 months; after that, the then-current standard APY applies. This is not a fixed 4.50% APY for a full year. No cash opening bonus verified.
products.securityNotes: Marcus's official app page describes biometric login, 128-bit SSL encryption, and multi-factor authentication.

products.rateNotes: Variable APY; Ally states it may change after opening.
products.fees: No monthly maintenance fee; no minimum balance requirement.
products.access: Online and mobile app; daily compounding; up to 10 limited withdrawals/transfers per statement cycle under Ally's account terms.
products.opening: No minimum deposit to open or earn APY. Ally's account-opening guidance says an account must be funded within 30 days or it may close. Standard eligibility and identity checks apply.
products.offer: Referral offer: $100 welcome bonus with an eligible personal referral link and enrollment by 2026-12-31. For Savings, set up a monthly recurring ACH transfer of any amount (or qualifying direct deposit) and complete at least one per month for 3 consecutive months. Account must remain open and in good standing through payout. New-friend exclusions apply.
products.securityNotes: Ally lists multi-factor authentication, encryption, account monitoring, automatic logout, and an online/mobile unauthorized-transaction guarantee subject to its reporting terms.

products.rateNotes: 3.25% APY is a variable new-savings-customer offer for balances of at least $25,000. A balance below $25,000 earns the standard or relationship rate instead; the live rate table lists the standard rate as 0.01% APY. The October 7, 2026 addendum says the new-customer offer applies in all states excluding Colorado.
products.fees: $12 monthly service fee; avoid with at least $3,500 minimum daily balance each fee period (or another stated waiver condition).
products.access: Online and Wells Fargo Mobile; account offers branch access and optional check-writing.
products.opening: To qualify for the 3.25% offer, the primary owner must not have owned, jointly owned, been trustee of, or held a trust on a Wells Fargo consumer savings account in the preceding 30 days; put at least $25,000 in the new Platinum Savings account within 30 days; then maintain a collected balance of at least $25,000 each day. The $25 opening deposit is separate from the $25,000 qualifying balance.
products.offer: Conditional new-customer promotional variable APY, not a cash bonus. Rate is variable and may change. If a daily balance falls below $25,000, standard or relationship rate applies for that day.
products.securityNotes: Wells Fargo says its Mobile app Security Center lets customers check and update security settings, review best practices, and get scam-prevention tips.

products.rateNotes: Capital One's official account comparison page lists 3.20% APY as of 2026-10-21. Its separate 360 Performance Savings product page and linked disclosure rendered the rate as 'NaN' when checked on 2026-10-22. The numeric rate is shown from the official comparison page but flagged as an official-site inconsistency; reconfirm on the application/account disclosure before opening.
products.fees: No monthly service fee and no minimum to open or maintain.
products.access: Capital One Mobile app; online and branch/Café access. No ATM withdrawal directly from this savings product (transfer to checking first).
products.opening: Applicants must be at least 18, meet the stated U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent resident and U.S. physical-address criteria, provide SSN or ITIN and a U.S.-based mobile number, and link a U.S.-chartered bank account for funding. Approval is required; fund within 60 days.
products.offer: No general savings cash bonus was confirmed on the reviewed official pages. Capital One says offers may be targeted; do not assume eligibility without a current offer code/terms.
products.securityNotes: Capital One lists biometric login, real-time alerts, debit-card lock/unlock, and transaction detail tools.

products.rateNotes: For the New York basic Citi Savings tier, the official promotional table lists a 0.98% blended APY on qualifying $25,000–$999,999 balances. This annualized APY reflects 3.75% promotional interest for up to three months plus the then-current 0.03% standard rate for the remainder of one year, assuming neither changes. It is not a recurring standard rate and requires at least $25,000 in qualifying New-to-Citibank Funds.
products.fees: $4.50 monthly service fee, waived with a $500+ average monthly savings balance or Citi checking; also waived during the opening month and first three full calendar months per current disclosures.
products.access: Citi Mobile app, Citi Online and branch access; eligible customers can use mobile check deposit. Savings account does not generally include checks or debit card.
products.opening: No minimum opening deposit. Apply in a branch, through Citi Online, or Citi Mobile; identity and account approval requirements apply. The promotion is limited to eligible new accounts opened no later than 2026-10-22. Zero-balance accounts may close after 90 days.
products.offer: Not a cash bonus. Eligible new Citi Savings accounts opened July 14–October 22, 2026 may earn 3.75% promotional interest for up to three months with at least $25,000 in New-to-Citibank Funds deposited within the first 10 business days. Citi checks the qualifying balance on the 11th business day; falling below the required amount thereafter ends the promotional rate. Maximum promotional interest is $10,000. The advertised 0.98% APY is the one-year blended illustration for the basic New York tier; offer ends for openings after 2026-10-22.
products.securityNotes: Citi describes 128-bit SSL encryption, additional authentication for sensitive or unusual activity, biometric sign-in options, and controls to block mobile access if credentials are believed compromised.

products.rateNotes: Variable APY, advertised accurate 2026-10-21; daily compounding and monthly interest crediting. Rates can change at any time.
products.fees: No monthly fees and no minimum balance required to open or earn the APY.
products.access: Amex App and online access; no ATM card, debit card, or checks are provided. Transfers and eligible mobile check deposit are available.
products.opening: Apply online, subject to approval and identity verification. Amex requires personal information including legal name, address, birth date, phone/email and a taxpayer identification number (SSN or ITIN). Personal, family, or household use; individual or joint ownership.
products.offer: No current general cash bonus or savings-rate promotion was confirmed in the reviewed official sources.
products.securityNotes: Amex says savings accounts use mandatory multi-factor authentication, 128-bit SSL, encrypted data and an automatic five-minute inactivity logout.

products.rateNotes: Variable rate: 3.50% APY below $250,000 and 3.65% APY for $250,000–$1,000,000. One-year examples below use deposits no greater than $235,000, so the 3.50% tier applies. Rates may change without notice.
products.fees: No monthly maintenance fee and no minimum deposit to open. Other fees may apply in specified circumstances under the account terms.
products.access: Barclays US App and online banking; mobile check deposit supported. Digital account; no branch access is advertised for this product.
products.opening: No minimum opening balance. Standard application and identity verification apply. New-customer bonus eligibility is separate from account opening and requires meeting the promotion's funding and holding terms. Zero-balance accounts may close after six months; account maximum is $1,000,000.
products.offer: $200 bonus for a new Barclays customer who opens by 2026-10-31, deposits at least $25,000 within 30 days, and maintains at least $25,000 for 120 consecutive days; bonus is added about 60 days later. Offer terms may change or be cancelled.
products.securityNotes: Barclays describes TLS/SSL encryption, firewalls, encrypted information, automatic session timeout and one-time passcodes for password reset; its app page also describes password protection and encryption.

products.group: National online bank · AARP membership required
products.rateNotes: AARP-member-exclusive variable APY of 4.25% across the listed balance tiers; the bank says this rate is accurate as of 2026-10-07. A current active AARP membership number is required to open. Rates may change without notice.
products.fees: No monthly maintenance or annual fee; other fees may apply in specified circumstances under account terms.
products.access: Barclays US App and online banking; mobile check deposit supported. Digital account; no branch access is advertised for this product.
products.opening: An active AARP membership and current membership number are required to apply. No minimum opening balance. Standard bank application and identity verification apply. Maximum $1,000,000 per account; zero-balance accounts may close after six months.
products.offer: $400 bonus for a new Select Savings from Barclays customer who is an active AARP member, opens by 2026-10-31, funds at least $40,000 within 30 days, and maintains at least $40,000 for 120 consecutive days. Bonus is added about 60 days later and is treated as taxable interest; membership is required. This is separate from the 4.25% variable APY.
products.securityNotes: Barclays describes TLS/SSL encryption, firewalls, encrypted information, automatic session timeout and one-time passcodes for password reset; its app page also describes password protection and encryption.

products.apyDate: 2026-10-21 rates shown for default ZIP 55402; New York rate unconfirmed
products.rateNotes: U.S. Bank advertises up to 3.50% APY with a qualifying Smartly Checking, Safe Debit, or Smartly Visa relationship and at least $25,000 combined qualifying balances, but rates vary by location. The rate tool continued to show its default ZIP 55402 even when queried with 10001 and also displayed a temporary rate-service warning. No New York-specific rate was confirmed, so APY and returns are blank.
products.fees: $5 monthly maintenance fee; may be waived with qualifying U.S. Bank Smartly Checking, Safe Debit, or Smartly Visa relationship.
products.access: U.S. Bank Mobile App and online banking; branch access and U.S. Bank ATM access.
products.opening: Apply online, in a branch, or through the mobile app. U.S. Bank states applicants must be at least 18 and a legal U.S. resident for individual online accounts; have a Social Security number, valid government-issued photo ID and a $25 opening deposit. Approval and identity verification apply.
products.offer: No general standalone savings cash bonus confirmed. The account advertises a relationship APY up to 3.50% at qualifying balances with an eligible linked product, but the exact applicable New York APY remains unverified.
products.securityNotes: U.S. Bank's Security Center supports biometric login, two-step verification, password updates and account alerts; its published Digital Security Guarantee addresses unauthorized online/mobile transactions subject to terms.

products.apyDate: Location-specific; not confirmed for this comparison
products.rateNotes: Chase requires a ZIP code to display the live rate table and says rates may vary by market. No New York ZIP-specific APY was confirmed from the official rate page in this review; left blank rather than infer.
products.fees: $5 monthly service fee; Chase lists waivers including a $300 daily beginning balance or $25+ in qualifying recurring automatic transfers. Check current terms.
products.access: Chase Mobile app; online and branch access.
products.opening: Online or branch application; Chase says applicants provide address, email, Social Security number and contact details; subject to approval.
products.offer: Current official offer through 2027-01-27: $100 for at least $5,000 in new money deposited within 30 days and maintained for 90 days; $200 for at least $10,000 under the same timing. New-customer, offer-code, prior-bonus and account-status restrictions apply. One-time bonus, not APY.
products.securityNotes: Chase lists encryption, biometric app login, additional validation checks, and suspicious-activity safeguards.

products.apyDate: Location-specific; not confirmed for this comparison
products.rateNotes: The official rate page requires a ZIP/county selection and links a location-specific PDF. No current New York APY was confirmed; left blank rather than infer from generic or out-of-market data.
products.fees: $8 monthly maintenance fee; first six months waived for new accounts; then fee-waiver criteria apply (including a $500 minimum daily balance or qualifying relationship/age conditions).
products.access: Bank of America Mobile Banking app; online and branch access.
products.opening: Personal account; $100 minimum opening amount. Full approval and application criteria depend on the current application and location-specific disclosures.
products.offer: No generally available savings cash-opening bonus verified in the official sources reviewed. Do not confuse checking or credit-card offers with a savings-account offer.
products.securityNotes: Bank of America describes two-factor authentication, account alerts, push notifications, and a security center/meter.
